strings.long:
R0 DIAGNOSTIC
No effect yet. Its TOTAL level (including +skills, not capped at 20)

r7_single_echo.description: R7: Echo supplies its TOTAL level to the stance carry stats (no effect of its own)

strings.long:
R7 DIAGNOSTIC
No effect of its own. Each total level adds +10 Strength to Conflagration and +50% Defense to Cryostasis.
